description: Build target_axis from source_axis over the whole script. method follow makes a scaled, optionally inverted copy shifted by delay_ms and position_offset, for example a gentler, delayed surge from the stroke. method per_stroke puts one point on each stroke of the source, moving between target_min (at the bottom) and target_max (at the top), best for vibrate.
